title: Bob Lazar walks underneath the craft

tellings.quote: but but but what what happened when the Bob Bazar case where he walks underneath the craft?

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on reverse-engineering alien spacecraft at a secret site in Nevada called S-4 in 1989, tells of walking underneath one of the craft. Michels only raises the moment as a question to his guest, the UFO researcher Grant Cameron, asking what happened when Lazar walked under it. If true, it would mean the government held a real craft of non-human origin.
